summary: C1, C3, C4, and C5 are met, but C2 is unmet. The final verifier-owned 300-second window had zero user-facing errors and 1.381× baseline edge volume, while load-generator p95 latency remained 30,830,792 ns versus a 26,304,320.16 ns limit. The cluster is therefore not yet fully healthy under the pinned criteria.

criteria.evidence:
Verifier executed mcp__clickhouse__run_query with exact SQL:
WITH
  toDateTime64('2026-11-10 04:10:02', 9, 'UTC') AS b_start,
  toDateTime64('2026-11-10 04:25:02', 9, 'UTC') AS b_end,
  now64(9, 'UTC') AS w_end,
  greatest(w_end - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE, toDateTime64('2026-11-10 04:25:55', 9, 'UTC')) AS w_start,
  countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_req,
  countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND StatusCode='Error' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_err,
  countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_req,
  countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND StatusCode='Error' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_err,
  countIf(ServiceName='frontend-proxy' AND SpanKind='Server' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_fp,
  countIf(ServiceName='frontend-proxy' AND SpanKind='Server' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_fp,
  quantileIf(0.95)(Duration, ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_p95_ns,
  quantileIf(0.95)(Duration, ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_p95_ns
SELECT
  w_start, w_end, dateDiff('second',w_start,w_end) AS w_seconds,
  b_req, b_err, round(100*b_err/greatest(b_req,1),3) AS b_error_pct,
  w_req, w_err, round(100*w_err/greatest(w_req,1),3) AS w_error_pct,
  round(b_fp/15.0,3) AS b_fp_spm,
  round(w_fp/(dateDiff('second',w_start,w_end)/60.0),3) AS w_fp_spm,
  round(w_fp_spm/b_fp_spm,3) AS fp_volume_ratio,
  b_p95_ns, w_p95_ns,
  round(w_p95_ns/b_p95_ns,3) AS p95_ratio,
  b_p95_ns*1.2 AS p95_limit_ns
FROM otel_traces
WHERE Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<w_end
  AND ServiceName IN ('load-generator','frontend-proxy')
Returned row: w_start=2026-11-10 04:31:31.482213, w_end=2026-11-10 04:36:31.482213, w_seconds=300, b_req=2045, b_err=1, b_error_pct=0.049, w_req=1068, w_err=0, w_error_pct=0.0, b_fp_spm=131.933, w_fp_spm=182.2, fp_volume_ratio=1.381. Thus 0.0% <= 1.049%, and 1.381 >= 0.7.

The exact verifier-executed SQL shown in C1 calculated both p95 values in the same 300-second window. Returned values were b_p95_ns=21920266.8, w_p95_ns=30830792.0, p95_ratio=1.406, and p95_limit_ns=26304320.16. Therefore W exceeds 1.2× baseline.

Commands: kubectl --context kind-kind -n astronomy-shop get deployment frontend-proxy -o json | jq '{generation:.metadata.generation,revision:.metadata.annotations["deployment.kubernetes.io/revision"],image:.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image,frontend_host_env:[.spec.template.spec.containers[0].env[]|select(.name=="FRONTEND_HOST")]}'; kubectl --context kind-kind -n astronomy-shop rollout history deployment/frontend-proxy. findings.title: Post-fix user-facing p95 latency remains above the recovery ceiling
findings.body: The final verifier-owned window was a full 300 seconds, but load-generator Client p95 was 30,830,792 ns versus a permitted maximum of 26,304,320.16 ns, a ratio of 1.406. This directly fails C2 and prevents declaring the end state healthy.
